text:
nicole-peopleops: Quick update  we've rolled out a handbook revision for 'Benefits & Covered Dependents' focused on domestic/partner coverage, name-change support, and inclusive language. Effective date: 2026-05-01. Please read and complete the 8-min acknowledgment + 6-min microtraining by 2026-05-15. Link: https://handbook.redwood.com/benefits/domestic-partner-update

pradeep-eng: Thanks. Does this affect current beneficiary designations or just new enrollments?

nicole-peopleops: Good Q  beneficiary designations remain as filed. The update clarifies eligibility and adds a voluntary name-change stipend process and a step-by-step for updating benefits portals and beneficiary records. New enrollments and changes on/after 2026-05-01 follow the updated rules.

zoe-manager: For managers: will we get a roster of who has domestic-partner coverage so we can help folks update records? Some of my team asked for help updating dependents after a name change.

nicole-peopleops: Managers will receive a completion and opt-in roster the day after the LMS reminders. We will not expose private dependent names in the CSV; instead the roster has flags (needs-update, opted-in-for-stipend) and anonymized counts. Managers can direct employees to People Ops for 1:1 assistance.

pradeep-eng: Is the name-change stipend only for legal documentation costs or broader (IDs, passport, etc.)?

nicole-peopleops: Stipend covers documented name-change expenses up to $500 (IDs, passport, social security docs, court filing fees). Finance/Comp will handle reimbursements; process and expense code BEN-NAMECHANGE are on the page.

zoe-manager: Will contractors be eligible for the stipend or dependent coverage? We have a 1099 temp who asked.

nicole-peopleops: Contractors are not eligible for dependent medical coverage but we added a contractor resource guide that describes community health stipend options and a separate 1099 name-change reimbursement policy for long-term contractors (12+ months) subject to vendor agreement. Details on the handbook page.

lms-bot: Microtraining assigned  "Inclusive Benefits: Domestic Partner & Name-Change Support" (6 min). Auto-assigned to all benefits-eligible staff. Reminder scheduled at 09:00 PT tomorrow. Course: https://lms.redwood.com/courses/inclusive-benefits-2026

pradeep-eng: Nice. Any change to how dependents are verified? My partner had trouble uploading certain docs last year.

nicole-peopleops: We've expanded accepted documents to include combination verification (e.g., household affidavit + joint lease) for certain jurisdictions, and added an international exceptions flow. The handbook has a table of accepted docs per region. If you hit a local-doc issue, ping people-ops and we'll route to Legal/Benefits.

sara-legal: A note from Legal: we updated the verification language to avoid unnecessary data collection and to ensure minimal retention per data minimization principles. Where extra documents are required by local law, we'll request those specifically and log them with limited access.

mika-comp: Finance note: reimbursements for name-change are taxable in some jurisdictions; we've added a short faq with tax treatment examples and a contact for payroll. Use expense code BEN-NAMECHANGE when submitting receipts.

zoe-manager: Managers need a short script to send to teams. Can you add a "What to tell your team" box with copy-paste lines?

nicole-peopleops: Yep  added 3 manager scripts: (1) announcement blurb, (2) 1:1 nudge template, (3) privacy reassurance line. Example blurb: "We've updated benefits to better support domestic partners and name changes. Please review the handbook and complete a short acknowledgment and microtraining by May 15. People who need help updating records can DM @nicole-peopleops." Feel free to copy.

pradeep-eng: If someone is mid-enrollment or mid-change when the policy takes effect, what applies?

nicole-peopleops: No retroactive reductions to already-approved coverage. If a change was submitted before 2026-05-01, we honor the prior submission. Updates submitted on/after 2026-05-01 use the new rules. We added an FAQ section for edge cases.

zoe-manager: Will managers get visibility into who opted into the name-change stipend? I'd prefer to let people apply privately.

nicole-peopleops: Stipend applications are private and processed by Benefits/Finance. The manager roster will only show anonymized counts and a "requires assistance" flag (yes/no). No individual stipend amounts or receipts will be shared with managers.

pradeep-eng: Any changes to enrollment deadlines or windows?

nicole-peopleops: No change to open enrollment windows; this is a policy clarification and new stipend process that sits alongside existing enrollment.

lms-bot: Manager roster export scheduled  completion & flags will be emailed to nicole-peopleops at 09:10 PT the day after reminders.
